Wells-Riley infection probability per location

Source: R/setting_specific_ach.R
ach_to_p_inf.Rd

Computes the absolute (unnormalised) single-exposure Wells-Riley infection probability for each location in a setting:

$$p_{inf}(i) = 1 - \exp(-r \cdot C_{ss}(i) \cdot RR_{tv} \cdot t)$$ $$C_{ss}(i) = (I \cdot \pi) / (\alpha_i \cdot V), \quad \alpha_i = ACH_i + k_D$$

Unlike convert_ach_to_riskiness(), the returned values are not normalised against a within-setting reference, so they are directly comparable across setting types. This is required when pooling locations from different settings for joint intervention targeting, where a within-setting normalisation would make equal values from different settings represent unequal absolute risk.

Usage

ach_to_p_inf(ach_values, parameters_list, setting)

Arguments

ach_values

Numeric vector of per-location baseline ACH values (1/hour), as returned by generate_setting_specific_ach().

parameters_list

A list of model parameters as generated by get_parameters(). The Wells-Riley parameters and the setting volume (volume_per_person_<setting>) are read from here.

setting

Character. One of "workplace", "school", "leisure", or "household". Used to select the appropriate volume_per_person_*.

Value

Numeric vector of per-location infection probabilities, same length as ach_values.

See also

Other setting-specific ACH: convert_ach_to_riskiness(), generate_setting_specific_ach(), set_default_ach(), set_setting_specific_ach()
